acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a multigenerational home addition or ADU in San Marcos varies significantly based on size, design complexity, materials, and site conditions. A basic ADU or addition might start from around $100,000 to $150,000, but custom designs, higher-end finishes, and extensive site work can easily push costs higher. Factors like utility hookups, foundation type, and interior fixtures all influence the final price.
